definition: a tall block with many homes in it
description: A modern red-brick apartment building with rows of balconies glows in low golden sun. A young woman in a white vest top and grey jeans pulls a big green velvet sofa up on a rope over the railing of her balcony until it lands inside, then cheers with a raised fist. Neighbours on the other balconies watch, two older women wave their arms and men lean over the railings. Washing and potted plants hang on the balconies and a van stands in the street below.

en.question: What is the young woman doing?

de.answer: Sie zieht ein Sofa auf ihren Balkon hoch.
de.question: Was macht die junge Frau?

es.answer: Está izando un sofá hasta su balcón.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer joven?

fr.answer: Elle hisse un canapé sur son balcon.
